metadata.inclusion: Tap the button once to add the device. The plug also supports SmartStart: scan the QR code on the side of the case or on the packaging box.
metadata.exclusion: Tap the button once to remove the device.
metadata.reset: Unplug the device. Press and hold the manual button, plug the device back in and continue holding the button for 3 seconds. Please use this procedure only when the primary controller is missing or otherwise inoperable.
